text:
Mira: Quick sync on Novacare onboarding quality & perf. They've reported higher-than-expected tail latency on live chat during peak hours. We're recommending a low-risk, staged optimization: run an int8 quant build, introduce a compact model for short-turn user queries, and add a latency-priority routing rule for premium users. Thoughts? :mag:
Sam: Sounds right. Do we have token-length histograms and a sample of long-context sessions?
Mira: Token distribution: 78% <=64, 16% 65-512, 6% >512. Long sessions are causing KV-cache cold starts when users paste long transcripts. Link to perf dashboard: https://redwood.metrics/novacare/trace-9a2b
Noah: From eng-ml: plan is -> (1) build & smoke-test int8 quant locally, run quick eval on 200 prompt pairs; (2) spin up gpt-compact-3 variant for <=64 token flows; (3) routing rule: premium users -> compact if expected_tokens<64; otherwise route to dedicated low-latency pool. Canary at 5% traffic.
Priya: We should capture semantic checks in the canary. If semantic similarity drops more than 0.04 average, block rollout. Also note customer wants no visible regressions for 72h.
Sam: Canary CLI we use: `redwood deploy canary --model gpt-compact-3 --customer novacare --pct 5 --monitor latency_p95,semantic_drift --rollback-on latency_p95>1.5`
DeployBot: Canary scheduled by Sam at 6172839488. Monitoring hooks attached. Alerts will post to #incidents if thresholds exceed.
Tina: I'll confirm a 2-hour slot with Novacare tomorrow 09:00-11:00 PT and include the rollback plan.
Mira: Action owners: Noah -> quant build + compact image; Sam -> execute canary; Priya -> define eval prompts & similarity metric; Tina -> calendar & customer comms. We'll reconvene after 24h of canary data. :white_check_mark:
